    - heading "Accessibility" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: A section named by its heading; each lane has a heading with its count – of everything in it, also beyond the limit
      - listitem: "Every button says what it does to which task – \"Approve: Refund $240 to Acme Corp\" – so a screen reader never hears three bare Approves"
      - listitem: "When an action finishes, a polite live region says so – \"Approved: Refund $240 to Acme Corp\" – and focus moves to Undo, so it never drops to the page"
      - listitem: Focusing anything in a card lights up its dot on the chart, the same as pointing at it; the chart itself is decorative and hidden from screen readers – everything on it is in the cards
      - listitem: Every time is a <time> with the full date; empty lanes say so in words
    - heading "Motion" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: The night is a small line chart with a peak per event and an area fading out below; when it opens, the line draws itself from left to right, each dot pops onto its peak as it's passed, its card fades in and the counts count along
      - listitem: Pointing at the chart draws a line through its whole height; close to an event it snaps there, the dot grows, its card lights up and a tip says what it was – pointing at a card lights up its dot
      - listitem: With prefers-reduced-motion everything shows at once
    - heading "Responsive behavior" [level=2]
    - list:
      - listitem: Every card is the same height and ends in the same line – a state tag (Done, Fixed, Approved) and the buttons – so acting on one never moves anything
      - listitem: Under 640px the three lanes stack
      - listitem: "Dark mode built in: switches when an ancestor (usually <html>) has the class dark or data-theme=\"dark\""
    - heading "Notes for AI" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Give your coding assistant this summary instead of screenshots.
    - list:
      - listitem: Give every event a unique id – Undo, focus and the chart keep track of cards by it
      - listitem: Events without a readable time are left out; ones before since or after until sit at the chart's edges
      - listitem: A lane shows up to limit cards – keep the rest for a full view and link to it from your page
      - listitem: since is when the person was last active – store it when they leave or go idle
      - listitem: Merge many small done events into one card with a count (38 tickets) instead of 38 cards – the count also makes its peak taller
      - listitem: Give needs cards a doneLabel in the past tense of their action – Approve → Approved, Send → Sent
      - listitem: Colors are variables on .ui-rcp, e.g. --ui-rcp-needs or --ui-rcp-failed
